disambiguation: Not just a navigation tool; it also manages file deletion, orphaned attachments, and empty folders.
extras: Statistics storage can be set to sync across devices or remain local to the device.
intentEvidence: Streamline your note review workflow with enhanced file navigation and deletion features.
motivation: I developed it to make navigation feel more natural after migrating from OneNote to Obsidian and it is helpful for navigating through notes made by the Obsidian Web Clipper.
problem: Manual navigation after deleting a note or processing a file can interrupt a focused review workflow.
summary: A file navigation and deletion tool that automatically moves to the next note after deleting the current one, while offering advanced file management features.
